# Everett, Notes of a conversation with Mr Zea (25 Sep 1825), NARA M31 roll 27: the code groups of all six coded sections,
# Andrew Beling with AI agents, transcribed 24-27 Oct 2026 from the NARA catalog images (frames 0112-0115, 0119-0121).
# One line per physical line of the manuscript: section, locus (frame + page half L/R + line on that half), groups.
# Sections = the six parts of the period decipherment (frames 0110-0111): S1-S2 MS p. 1, S3 pp. 2-3, S4 pp. 3-6,
# S5 pp. 14-15 (the "six lines"), S6 pp. 17-18.
# Marks: {d} lozenge after the group, {b+} cross below, {bv} tick below ({bv2}, {bv3} two or three), {slash} stroke
# after the group, {underline}, ? = digit uncertain. Section 5 uses the older spelling {diamond}, {below-plus},
# {below-v}, {above-caret}.
# This is our first-pass transcription, unchanged since October; it was NOT blind (the clear text and the period
# decipherment had been seen). The film check of 22 Nov 2026 (film_check/) shows it wrong at 18 of the 27 places
# where it differs from Brice Dudout's files and at three short runs; see comparison_with_dudout.tsv. It is offered
# as a third witness, not as a replacement for dudout/texts or ../everett1825_transcription.txt.
# 1201 groups.
